say:1:1230157001:1.text: Now, it's not just foggy at sea; there are also sea monsters out there!
say:1:1230157001:1.source_cn: 现在海上可不止大雾，在航线上，还有海怪出没！

say:2:1230157002:1.text: Rumor has it that the Dead Tide Fleet is the culprit behind everything!
say:2:1230157002:1.source_cn: 据说无论是大雾还是海怪，其实都是死潮舰队搞得鬼！

say:3:1230157003:1.text: The paper says that the fleet's trying to drive the Carmine Whispers out of Rustport with these tactics.
say:3:1230157003:1.source_cn: 报纸上说，他们是想凭借这些手段，来逼迫血薇帮离开锈锚港！

say:4:1230157004:1.text: You should buy a paper if you want more details!
say:4:1230157004:1.source_cn: 您要是还有什么问题想了解，可以买一份新鲜报！
